semantics.R1_j: one-edge matching incident with target root j
semantics.X_j: two-edge matching with target root j unmatched

coefficient_matrices.convention: Raw integral Gram: sum over ordered root embeddings of z(root) z(root)^T.  A coefficient at union order s counts ordered flag pairs whose vertex union is the whole H_s.

hostile_full_eight_type_zero_fill_contro.meaning: Set every non-visible H9 coefficient to zero even in the three X_j-X_k cross entries which are not closed.  This is stronger than the licensed 19-column principal-block test and is recorded only as a counter-control.

exact_boundary.minimal_counter_control: The complete 8-type zero-fill matrix is already PSD of rank 7.  Within all 74 visible-derived triangle-rooted order-six flags, the largest principal blocks whose order-nine support is contained in the 19 masks have size two and are the three isomorphic {X_j,P} blocks.
first_missing_data: At the same union order 9, any block containing two distinct X_j needs 9 additional locally admissible H9 masks outside the visible 19.
If H9 support must remain fixed to the 19, a generic two-root order-six flag without the shared unique mate first has a diagonal of union order 10.

For triangle-rooted square Grams, increasing from three to four free vertices raises the next diagonal union order to 11; this is also the first order at which one doubled D source can be displayed explicitly.
